containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
ENV="prod"
echo "===I2822A_R2_START env=$ENV host=$(hostname) utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache curl >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1; echo "apk_rc=$?"
doc(){
  t=$1; lab=$2; p=$3
  B=/tmp/d.$$
  code=$(curl -s -m 30 -o "$B" -w '%{http_code}|%{size_download}|%{content_type}' "http://$t$p" 2>/dev/null); rc=$?
  echo "DOC [$lab] $p rc=$rc -> $code"
  echo "-----BEGIN_BODY $lab $p-----"
  head -c 150000 "$B" 2>/dev/null
  echo ""
  echo "-----END_BODY $lab $p-----"
  rm -f "$B"
}
probe(){
  t=$1; lab=$2; shift 2
  for p in "$@"; do
    B=/tmp/b.$$
    code=$(curl -s -m 8 -o "$B" -w '%{http_code}|%{size_download}|%{content_type}' "http://$t$p" 2>/dev/null); rc=$?
    echo "HIT [$lab] $p rc=$rc -> $code :: $(head -c 300 "$B" 2>/dev/null | tr '\r\n' ' ')"
    rm -f "$B"
  done
}
probe 'lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-data-c6480e54a84f2644.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-data '/dms/data-dashboard' '/dms/my-filters'
doc 'lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-data-c6480e54a84f2644.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-data /swagger/api-docs
doc 'lazamedical-prod01-usw2-notif-eafa1811fd6f6f78.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-notif /swagger/api-docs
doc 'lazamedical-prod01-usw2-auth-8ba7c7856a888742.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-auth /swagger/api-docs
doc 'lazamedical-prod01-usw2-authz-b28f0d1484208416.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-authz /swagger/api-docs
doc 'lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-s3-2a3b26f15d64ba78.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-s3 /openapi.json
doc 'lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-meta-149485d8eeef4b86.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-meta /openapi.json
doc 'lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-deid-f957f3b6a98392fd.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-deid /openapi.json
echo "===I2822A_R2_DONE env=$ENV utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
